description.en: The name of the logical Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC. Format: 2010-01-21T09:50:23Z.

description.zh:
时间聚合粒度，单位：分钟。

默认为5分钟，取值范围：5~1440。
description.en:
The aggregation granularity. Unit: minutes.

Default value: 5. Valid values: 5 to 1440.
The beginning of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC. Format: 2010-01-21T09:50:23Z.

descriptions.zh: 带宽和存储用量查询聚合粒度不可超过一天，聚合数据处理是将一段时间内点位数据分别取最大值。
descriptions.en: The query and aggregation granularity of bandwidth and storage usage cannot exceed one day. Data aggregation is to collect the maximum values of usage data within a period of time.
